answer: Each agent must submit a zero-knowledge attestation of a unique TPM/SGX enclave, committing its measurement into the meadow state tree; knoll is a VDF-ordered hash anchor, and onyx is the consensus contract that verifies proofs and locks quadratic O(N^2) bonds.
